newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says Q2 data shows yr-end GDP up 2.3 percent.
newsitem.headline: Spain says Q2 data shows yr-end GDP up 2.3 percent.

text.p: Spanish economic growth of 1.9 percent in the second quarter confirms a recovery and indicates that full-year GDP growth will be 2.3 percent as forecast, the Economy Ministry said on Wednesday.
In a statement the government highlighted a recovery in private consumption and a rebound in investment in capital goods.
Private consumption grew 1.9 percent in the second quarter year on year, up from 1.7 percent in the first quarter.
